name: maui-ui-patterns
description: Fix MAUI UI layout, state, and automation issues. USE FOR: `CollectionView` scrolling, DataTemplate bindings, command bindings, Grid/FlexLayout sizing, binding-driven states, avoiding `ScrollView` parents, stable AutomationIds, `x:DataType`, EmptyView/loading/error states. DO NOT USE FOR: Shell routes, full accessibility, vendor-specific controls.
